099  private static void postFieldEvent(EventObjectBacktrace eo) {
100    addToEventHistory(eo);
101    getGlobalEventBus().post(eo);
102  }

119    // May want to extend to handling local EventBus per Frame/Panel;
120    // Use either/both source/rs to find a local eventBus.

124  /**
125   * Post an error column change event.
126   * @param source SsComponent modifying the column
127   * @param value new value
128   */
129  public static void postColumnChangeStartError(SsComponent source, Object value) {
130    ColumnChangeStartEvent ev = new ColumnChangeStartEvent(source, value, true);
131    logger.log(DEBUG, () -> ev.toString());
132    postFieldEvent(ev);

141  public static void postColumnChangeDone(ChangeEventData startEv) {
142    ColumnChangeDoneEvent ev = new ColumnChangeDoneEvent(startEv);
143    logger.log(DEBUG, () -> ev.toString());
144    postFieldEvent(ev);

147  /**
148   * Post an undo/redo event and if value an error.
149   * @param source SsComponent modifying the column
150   * @param value new value
151   * @param isError value is an error
152   */
153  public static void postColumnUndoRedo(SsComponent source, Object value, boolean isError) {
154    ColumnUndoRedoEvent ev = new ColumnUndoRedoEvent(source, value, isError);
155    if (isError)
156      logger.log(DEBUG, () -> ev.toString());
157    postFieldEvent(ev);
158  }

168  ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
169  //
170  // KeyboardFocusManager Tracking
171  //
172  private static PropertyChangeListener listenerFocusOwner;
173  private static PropertyChangeListener listenerManagingFocus;
174  private static KeyboardFocusManager KFM;
175
176  /** @return Current KeyboardFocusManager */
177  public static KeyboardFocusManager getKFM() {
178    return KFM;
179  }
180
181  private static void trackCurrentKFM() {
182    KFM = KeyboardFocusManager.getCurrentKeyboardFocusManager();
183
184    KFM.addPropertyChangeListener("focusOwner", listenerFocusOwner);
185    KFM.addPropertyChangeListener("managingFocus", listenerManagingFocus);
186  }
187
188  /** keep track of currentKeyboardFocusManager and switch listeners as needed */
189  private static void setupTrackerForKFM() {
190    if (listenerFocusOwner != null)
191      return; // Could throw an exception
192
193    // broadcast focus changes
194    listenerFocusOwner = pce -> {
195      globalEventBus.post(new FocusChangeEvent(pce));
196    };
197    // detect change in focus manager,
198    // remove listeners from old, move them to current
199    listenerManagingFocus = pce -> {
200      if (Boolean.FALSE.equals(pce.getNewValue())) {
201        logger.log(INFO, "switching to new KeyboardFocusManager");
202        KeyboardFocusManager oldKFM = (KeyboardFocusManager) pce.getSource();
203
204        oldKFM.removePropertyChangeListener("focusOwner", listenerFocusOwner);
205        oldKFM.removePropertyChangeListener("managingFocus", listenerManagingFocus);
206
207        trackCurrentKFM();
208      }
209    };
210    // kick things off; start tracking current focus manager
211    trackCurrentKFM();
212  }
213
214  private static class BusExceptionMonitor implements SubscriberExceptionHandler {
215    @Override
216    @SuppressWarnings("CallToPrintStackTrace")
217    public void handleException(Throwable exception, SubscriberExceptionContext context) {
218      exception.printStackTrace();
219      logger.log(Level.ERROR, () -> "BusException: " + exception.getMessage());
220      logger.log(Level.ERROR, () -> "    " + context.getEventBus());
221      logger.log(Level.ERROR, () -> "    " + context.getSubscriber());
222      logger.log(Level.ERROR, () -> "    " + context.getSubscriberMethod());
223      if (context.getEvent() instanceof EventObjectBacktrace eobt
224          && eobt.getEventBacktrace() != null)
225        logger.log(Level.ERROR, () -> "    " + context.getEvent(), eobt.getEventBacktrace());
226      else
227        logger.log(Level.ERROR, () -> "    " + context.getEvent());
228      StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder("    ");
229      logger.log(Level.ERROR, () -> latestEvents("Where", 20, sb).toString());
230    }
231  }
232
233  //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
234  //
235  // Event tracking for debug
236  //
237
238  private record EventHistoryItem(String ev, Throwable bt) {}
239
240  private static final int N_EVENTS = 50;
241  private static final Queue<EventHistoryItem> latestEvents = new ArrayDeque<>();
242  static void addToEventHistory(EventObjectBacktrace event) {
243    if (!SsUtils.isJunit() && !logger.isLoggable(DEBUG))
244      return;
245    while (latestEvents.size() >= N_EVENTS) latestEvents.remove();
246    // Convert event to String so there are no references
247    // (like RowSet, RowsModel) in the history.
248    latestEvents.add(new EventHistoryItem(event.toString(), event.getEventBacktrace()));
249  }
250
251  @SuppressWarnings("FieldMayBeFinal")
252  private static int N_DUMP = 20;
253
254  /**
255   *
256   * @param tag
257   */
258  @SuppressWarnings("UseOfSystemOutOrSystemErr")
259  public static void dumpLatestEvents(String tag) {
260    StringBuilder sb = latestEvents(tag, N_DUMP, null);
261    System.err.println(sb.toString());
262    //logger.log(INFO, sb.toString());
263  }
264
265  /**
266   *
267   * @param tag
268   * @param limit
269   * @param _sb
270   * @return
271   */
272  public static StringBuilder latestEvents(String tag, int limit, StringBuilder _sb) {
273    StringBuilder sb = _sb == null ? new StringBuilder() : _sb;
274    sb.append(sf("******* %s All Events (%d) *******\n", tag, latestEvents.size()));
275    latestEvents.stream().limit(limit).forEach(
276        (evhist) -> sb.append("    ").append(evhist.ev()).append('\n'));
277    sb.setLength(sb.length() - 1);
278    return sb;
279  }
280}
